narrative.overview: This record covers the shipped character and its inspection scene only. The user-confirmed friendly teen, teal hoodie and small backpack extend Digi-world's simplified 3D world. The root README establishes a children's digital-security game; the small clothing shield expresses that theme without changing the environment's identity.
keyCharacteristics: Rounded, editable forms and a welcoming face.
Muted teal clothing with warm backpack and sneaker accents.
Soft idle motion, grounded strides and a readable greeting.

rules.name: The Clothing Identity Rule
rules.body: Keep the teal hoodie, warm small backpack and cream details legible together when extending this character.

rules.name: The Grounded Motion Rule
rules.body: Walking and jogging use alternating leg phases, lifted return strides and ankle counter-rotation to keep soles level. Motion blends smoothly with speed; quiet breathing and periodic blinking support idle, while the right arm carries the greeting.

dos: Do preserve the confirmed clothing identity and welcoming expression when extending this asset.
Do inspect front, rear and moving poses, including sole contact and the visible shield face.
donts: Don't treat preview composition or lighting as a redesign of the game world.
Don't describe procedural Node3D animation as a skinned or retargetable rig.
